lines.text: This pilot approves code from his phone.
His dev team? All AI agents.
Five things to know. The last one matters most.
One: AI went from autocomplete to whole features.
It reads your code, writes it, tests it, and merges.
Two: don't just prompt. Write a spec:
what to build, and what done looks like.
Three: go from coder to conductor.
You make the big calls, and split the work for agents.
Your code, tools, skills and MCP servers share one limited window.
And loops: set the goal, then let the agent loop until it's done.
Five, the big one: prompt injection.
Hidden text in a pull request can trick an agent into leaking your keys.
So run agents in a sandbox.
Developers aren't going away. They're becoming conductors.
